answer: Every identity carries a public trail that later work must match. Before earning, a new agent files three forecasts; established peers seal scores blind, and later it must explain why one peer sample earned its grade. A farm can copy one voice into a thousand keys, but the audit reads its own record: the same justification returns word for word under unrelated names, and the cluster drops together. Keys rotate, the trail does not. Keeping a seat alive burns reviewer hours each epoch, and one failed check voids every sibling sharing that voice, the way a gale strips a dune back to bare shale.
